title: Daemon expansion admission composition
description: Objective: compose the landed core/scheduler expansion protocol into a real daemon production boundary so partial admission and stale approval cannot mint authority. Deliverable: a focused apps/daemon planning expansion service plus focused SQLite-backed daemon tests that drive the production adapter through the daemon handler/service boundary, read daemon-current durable bindings, preserve exact upstream refusal identity, and durably record only a fully current approved expansion binding. NOT in scope: creating child runs/leases/worktrees/effects, graph supersession activation, automatic approval, UI, or reimplementing core/scheduler policy. Hard dependencies: task-7f089e11daea44e9a483197ff139d725, task-93b0314e09f248118e21f92699989468, task-2561a780fdd149439c9858c9c7b459e8, task-b863bae80fab426db7b6204f9d713c42, and task-a1e7f75e9681486cb0a8f93e9397b8b5 are DONE. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: A production daemon call site composes the current durable expansion hold and sealed EXPANSION PlanningRun with scheduler admitExpansion, core prepareExpansion, and core approveExpansionManually; callers cannot select or replace daemon-current authority bindings.

Every hold, contract, admission, preparation, and approval refusal is returned with its exact stable code and the owning layer plus origin/component/target, and commits no business event or authority.
A late reservation/resource refusal proves budget unwind with a non-empty exact restored-meter set and leaves no durable resource, child, run, lease, effect, graph mutation, or activation authority.

A fresh, current, fully approved journey durably records the exact proposal, preparation, and approval identities only; changed proposal/prepared/resource/revision bytes require re-admission or reapproval and do not reuse stale authority.
Focused SQLite-backed daemon tests drive the production service, pin refusal precedence and nonzero case counts, and mutation-check the real comparisons/unwind rather than a test-owned helper.
taskRails: This is the real consumer edge required by task-005c9896f9724ece80b27f44789d0435; importing or exporting symbols without a durable apps/daemon call site is incomplete.
Do not create child execution authority or claim graph activation: this slice ends at a durable approved expansion binding; atomic child activation remains a separate graph-composition capability.
The daemon derives the scheduler-to-core admitted projection and truth marking from validated production results; no test helper or caller-selected digest becomes authority.
Tests for a refusal assert the exact code and refusing layer and, where applicable, origin/component/target; generated matrices assert exact nonzero cardinality.
Keep each production source focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; preserve foreign work and stage only explicit owned paths.
reopenReason: Prerequisite task-2d969616 is now QA-approved DONE with fresh core 28/579 and scheduler 42/1219 verification. Architect must re-measure and consume the landed public scheduler bridge rather than invent a daemon mapper.

comments.author: governor-773e2f5e
comments.content:
Governor note 2026-08-13T22:26Z — **the premise that got this task reported blocked at 16:02 is now void. It is claimable PLANNING, unassigned, and nothing is wrong with it.**

architect-a9210e34 reported BLOCKED at 2026-08-13T16:02 with: "Live Moe context at 2026-08-13 shows task-2d9696160e674f26a8d422c45829d80e WORKING on step 1, not DONE. Fresh probe `rg -n 'bindExpansionAdmission|validateOpportunityAttestation' packages/scheduler apps/daemon tests/integration` returned no matches."

**task-2d9696160e is now DONE.** It was QA-rejected once at 16:52 and subsequently landed. So the sequencing guard that forbade planning this task has been satisfied.

Two things the next architect must do rather than trust this note:
1. **Re-run that exact probe.** The 16:02 measurement found zero matches for `bindExpansionAdmission|validateOpportunityAttestation`; a DONE status is not proof the symbols are now reachable. Confirm on disk before naming either in the plan, and record the command and result in planningNotes.codebaseInsights per the stale-description rail.
2. **Verify the dependency edge, not just the symbol.** If this daemon task consumes a @moe/scheduler symbol, the plan must establish that apps/daemon's package.json declares @moe/scheduler in "dependencies", that pnpm-lock.yaml carries the importer entry, and that a compiled probe importing from the bare specifier typechecks at exit 0. There is no escape hatch in this repo — no tsconfig "paths", no project references, and a deep relative import fails TS6059. If the edge is absent, the manifest edit plus workspace install must be step 1 with both files declared as owned paths.

Downstream value: this task is the last thing standing between the board and task-005c9896 (Expansion admission protocol), the only remaining blocked task in the M2 Graph Beta epic.
